# HGV Direct

> > HGV Direct is a specialist supplier of commercial vehicle parts for trucks, trailers, buses, coaches, and light commercial vehicles, featuring major brands like Haldex, Wabco, Knorr Bremse, and Iveco.

The site offers comprehensive parts catalogs organized by vehicle manufacturer (Scania, Iveco, ERF, Leyland) and component category (air brakes, axles, suspension, filters). HGV Direct specializes in trailer air brake systems, axle components, and consumables for the commercial vehicle industry.

## Key Topics

- Trailer Air Brakes
- Haldex Systems
- Wabco Components
- Knorr Bremse
- Trailer Axles (SAF, ROR Meritor)
- Iveco Eurocargo Parts
- Air Suspension Systems
- EBS & ECU Systems
- Levelling Valves
- Brake Components
- AdBlue Products
- Leyland Tiger Bus Parts
- Commercial Vehicle Filters
- Truck Consumables
- JCB Agricultural Parts

## Trailer Air Brake Systems

- [ECUs & EBS Systems](https://hgvdirect.co.uk/trailer-parts/trailer-air-brakes/ecus.html): Haldex and Wabco ECUs and EBS systems for trailer air brakes
- [Trailer Control Valves](https://hgvdirect.co.uk/trailer-parts/trailer-air-brakes/trailer-control-valves.html): Haldex trailer control valves for air brake systems
- [Knorr Bremse Levelling Valves](https://hgvdirect.co.uk/trailer-parts/trailer-air-brakes/levelling-valves/knorr-bremse.html): Knorr Bremse levelling valves for trailer air brake systems
- [Diagnostic Kits](https://hgvdirect.co.uk/trailer-parts/trailer-air-brakes/diagnostic-kits.html): Haldex diagnostic kits for trailer air brake systems

## Trailer Axles & Suspension

- [SAF Air Suspension](https://hgvdirect.co.uk/trailer-parts/truck-trailer-axles/saf-axles/saf-air-suspension.html): SAF air suspension components including air springs and shock absorbers
- [ROR Meritor Axles](https://hgvdirect.co.uk/trailer-parts/truck-trailer-axles/ror-meritor-axles.html): Ror Meritor axle parts and brake components for trailers

## Truck Parts by Manufacturer

- [Scania 4 Series Braking](https://hgvdirect.co.uk/truck-parts/scania/4-series/braking.html): Brake pads, discs, drums and calipers for Scania 4 Series trucks
- [Iveco Eurocargo ML180 E24S](https://hgvdirect.co.uk/truck-parts/iveco/eurocargo-ml180-e24s.html): Parts catalog for Iveco Eurocargo ML180 E24S trucks
- [Iveco Eurocargo 75E16](https://hgvdirect.co.uk/truck-parts/iveco/eurocargo-75e16.html): Parts catalog for Iveco Eurocargo 75E16 commercial vehicles
- [ERF EC10 Transmission & Clutch](https://hgvdirect.co.uk/truck-parts/erf/ec10/clutch.html): Transmission and clutch parts for ERF EC10/EC11 trucks

## General Trailer Parts & Accessories

- [Mudwings & Anti-Spray](https://hgvdirect.co.uk/trailer-parts/general-trailer-parts/mudwings.html): Mudwings, mudflaps and anti-spray accessories for HGV trailers

## Bus & Coach Parts

- [Leyland Tiger Filters](https://hgvdirect.co.uk/bus-coach-parts/leyland/tiger/filters.html): Fuel filters for Leyland Tiger buses and coaches

## Truck Consumables & Accessories

- [Tyre Products](https://hgvdirect.co.uk/by-category/truck-consumables/tyre-products.html): Tyre mounting paste, repair kits and maintenance products for trucks
- [Truck Rope](https://hgvdirect.co.uk/by-category/truck-body-components/truck-rope.html): Polypropylene rope in various sizes for cargo securing

## Optional

- [JCB Fastrack Parts](https://hgvdirect.co.uk/plant-agriculture-parts/jcb/fastrack.html): Parts catalog for JCB Fastrack agricultural tractors
